usage.label: devote A to B
usage.explanationZh: 將 A 奉獻在 B 之上。

usage.label: devote oneself to + N/V-ing
usage.explanationZh: 某人奉獻／致力於……；= dedicate oneself to + N/V-ing。

usage.label: play a vital role in...
usage.explanationZh: 在……方面扮演極重要的角色。

usage.label: accomplish a goal
usage.explanationZh: 達到目標；= achieve / attain a goal。

usage.label: a person of many accomplishments
usage.explanationZh: 有多樣才華的人；= a versatile person。

usage.label: contrast A with B
usage.explanationZh: 將 A 與 B 做對照。

usage.label: be far from... / be not... at all
schoolwork / assignment（作業）
usage.explanationZh: 表「作業」時 schoolwork 為不可數名詞，assignment 則為可數名詞。

usage.label: distinguish A from B
usage.explanationZh: 區別 A 與 B 的不同；= tell A from B。

usage.label: be distinguished for...
usage.explanationZh: 因……而出名；= be renowned / famous for...。

usage.label: make a comment on...
usage.explanationZh: 對……評論／發表意見；= comment on...。

usage.label: urge sb to + V
usage.explanationZh: 激勵某人做……；= call on sb to + V。
